name: creator
description: Original 2D flat-vector presenter: young South-Asian tech creator, short messy dark hair, light stubble, orange zip hoodie over a dark tee, black headphones around the neck. Chest/waist-up, bottom edge = crop line, transparent PNG.

swapGroups.note: idle_open/talk_a/talk_b/blink are pixel-identical outside the mouth/eye patch (same alpha). shocked shares idle body/alpha too.

regions._units: fractions of canvas [x0,y0,x1,y1], approximate, valid for idle/talk/blink/shocked

base.prompt: Flat 2D vector cartoon illustration of a friendly young South-Asian male tech content creator, chest-up portrait, front facing, looking at the viewer with a slight friendly smile, mouth closed. Warm brown skin, short messy dark black hair, light stubble shadow on the jaw (no beard, no glasses, no hat). He wears a bright orange zip hoodie open over a plain dark charcoal t-shirt, and a small pair of black over-ear headphones resting around his neck. Arms relaxed at his sides, hands out of frame. Style: clean flat vector cartoon like a modern explainer-video mascot, thick uniform dark brown-black outlines, flat solid colours with one simple hard-edged cel shadow tone, large simple expressive eyes, no gradients, no texture. Centered, the figure fills the frame width, cropped at mid-chest at the bottom edge, plain pure white background, no text, no logo.

prompts.talk_a: [face-crop edit] Change ONLY the mouth: slightly open as if mid-sentence, small open mouth, hint of upper teeth.
prompts.talk_b: [face-crop edit] Change ONLY the mouth: open wider as if saying 'ah', upper teeth, dark inside, a little tongue; nose does not move.
prompts.blink: [face-crop edit] Change ONLY the eyes: both closed in a natural blink.
prompts.shocked: [face-crop edit] Change ONLY the expression: eyes wide, small pupils, brows high, mouth a small round O.
prompts.point_up: Raises right hand beside face, index finger pointing straight up, brows slightly raised, confident smile. Keep everything else identical: same character, face, hair, orange hoodie, dark tee, headphones, flat vector style, thick outlines, cel shading, colours, framing, scale and position; plain white background; five fingers; no text.

prompts.<pose>_talk_a: [face-crop edit of each gesture pose] Change ONLY the mouth: slightly open as if mid-sentence.

poses.notes: Mouth/eye/shocked variants: edit a 2x face crop of idle, align (multi-scale NCC, scipy), paste only the changed mouth or eye patch onto idle with a feathered mask, keep idle alpha. Gesture poses: full-frame edit, head-template aligned (scale/offset) to idle; <3.5% scale treated as identity.

generation.postprocess: idle-coordinate canvas 1200x1320 cropped from 1200x1504, resized to 1000x1100, 14px alpha taper at top (hair tips touch top edge)
